mentions.name: Authbound
mentions.description: An eIDAS 2.0 / EUDI Wallet Plug & Play SDK integration that lets businesses adopt compliant digital identities without handling the compliance and technical complexity themselves. It uses cryptographic credential verification to make KYC roughly 90% cheaper than traditional document checks, with Qualified Electronic Signatures and EUDI Wallet payment systems planned for coming years.
mentions.problem: Businesses face a growing compliance and technical mess around EU-mandated digital identity regulations (eIDAS 2.0), and traditional document-based KYC checks are expensive.
mentions.audience: Businesses that don't want to figure out EU digital identity compliance and technical complexity themselves
mentions.source_excerpt: Working on Authbound. Digital identities are slowly becoming more prominent. With EU mandatory regulations, it will just boost this market. So we're building eIDAS 2.0 / EUDI Wallet Plug & Play SDK integration for businesses that don't want to figure out the compliance and technical mess themselves.
